tough.h2: Built for baths, bows and humidity
tough.html:
Yorkies get groomed more than most people. Baths, blow-dries, leave-in spray, the little top-knot bow. A printed tag gives up fast under all that.

Ours are laser engraved, so the words are cut into the metal instead of painted on top. No ink to wash off, flake off, or get chewed off by a jealous sibling.

Survives the spa schedule.

How engraving holds up →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. Our bulldogs also refuse to walk home. The yorkie lines are for owners who carry theirs.

sayings.h2: 8 yorkie sayings: big opinions, tiny tag
sayings.lead: Bred to chase rats. Now they chase the mailman, the vacuum and every bird that dares to exist. Name and number go on the back.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

items.q: Will baths and grooming ruin an engraved yorkie tag?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on the surface, so shampoo, blow-dryers and humidity have nothing to peel off.

items.q: Can I put my yorkie's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name and your phone number are engraved on the back.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for yorkies?
items.a: Eight on this page, about the size, the bark, the grooming and the refusal to walk anywhere. Or type your own in the builder and see what fits.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: If we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
